$comment: Model ladders, one per agent role. ADR-0018.
Ordered by preference: the guard runs the first rung that is not
rate-limited, per the ledger issue labeled model-limits.
The LAST rung is the floor. Nothing below it is reachable, so an
exhausted ladder means the agent skips this cycle rather than
silently dropping to a weaker model. ADR-0012's Opus 5 floor for the
BDFL is expressed that way and not as separate logic.
An empty ladder means: no --model flag, action default, never falls
back, never skipped for model reasons.
The BDFL owns this file (ADR-0012). It lives outside .github/ so
changing it is an ordinary app-token commit, not an admin-PAT
